P1.intent: Define the primitive: the LM finance-specific 'uncertainty' word-share, and UncAnsCEO (eq-2) as the raw CEO answer-uncertainty measure the decomposition operates on.
P1.serves: Establishes the raw input (UncAns) before P2 decomposes it; names the control shares (UncPre, UncQue).
P1.thin_claim: The dictionary is the established LM apparatus adopted in 2.1 P2 (callback) -- not re-justified here.
guardrails: RULE-COH-1: LM dictionary + presentation/Q&A split = CALLBACK P2; reference, do not re-justify.

propositions.statement: The uncertainty measure is the Loughran-McDonald finance-specific 'uncertainty' word list applied as a word-share, the established apparatus adopted in 2.1.

UncAnsCEO = UnctWordsAnsCEO / WordsAnsCEO -- the fraction of uncertainty words among all words the CEO speaks when answering analysts (DWZ eq-2). This is the raw input to the decomposition and the eq-4 LHS.

The measure is computed over the CEO presentation-vs-Q&A split; UncPreCEO (eq-1, presentation) and UncQue (eq-3, analyst questions) are the same word-share form, and enter the decomposition as controls rather than as the dependent variable.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Names the control shares + the split (callback).

propositions.statement: An anticipatory, deal-tracking signal must vary call-to-call within a single CEO's tenure, so it can only live in the call-varying residual, not the persistent manager-specific style -- as established in 2.1.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: One-clause callback to P4's locating argument.

propositions.statement: DWZ eq-4: UncAnsCEO_it = alpha + gamma_i*CEO_it + beta_s*Speech_sit + beta_k*FirmChars_kit + Year_t + epsilon_it, with ClarityCEO_i = -gamma_i and UncResCEO = epsilon_it. Speech = {UncPreCEO, UncQue, NegCall}; FirmChars = {SurpDec, EPSgrowth, StockRet, MarketRet}; plus Year fixed effects. ATTRIBUTION (advisor): this is DWZ's SPECIFICATION re-estimated on OUR sample -- the residual is our own (outputs .../ceo_clarity_residual.parquet), not DWZ's published residuals; prose must say 'DWZ's specification, estimated on our data'. If our bible control set differs from this verified set, it is a DWZ-STYLE decomposition, not literally eq-4 (this is why the Catch-3 bible cross-check is load-bearing).
propositions.role_in_paragraph: The decomposition equation + the DV definition.

propositions.statement: eq-4 is the precise operationalization of the 'call-level residual': it nets out the persistent style (gamma) AND observable call-level factors (UncPre, UncQue, NegCall, contemporaneous performance, year), so UncRes is narrower than a style-only residual -- a refinement of the 2.1 description, not a different object.

DWZ construct and use UncRes as an explanatory variable in their own market-response model; this paper's contribution is the anticipatory, disclosure-state READING of UncRes around undisclosed deals, not the measure itself.

Following DWZ, UncResCEO is the answer-uncertainty NET OF the scripted presentation (UncPreCEO), isolating the unscripted, call-specific component where the anticipation of an undisclosed deal WOULD surface; if any of that anticipation also leaks into the scripted, vetted remarks, the residual UNDERSTATES it (a conservative floor). By the same construction the residual is also net of analyst-question uncertainty (UncQue) and call negativity (NegCall), which grounds the scrutiny/tone reconciliation in 2.5 P4 (P4.4).
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Owns the UncPre residualization POSITIVELY (DWZ's isolation design, suggestive) + the conservative floor + the RULE-COH-8 net-of-UncQue/NegCall grounding -- absorbed here after the old P3 threat-paragraph was cut (user 'cut it' + DWZ evidence).
